name: HealthNote (NIP-101h)
shortDescription: Integrates with Nostr decentralized protocol to enable discovery, preparation, and publishing of standardized health and fitness data events while maintaining user privacy and control over sensitive information.

rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: NIP-101h MCP server provides tools for working with health and fitness data on the Nostr decentralized protocol, developed by HealthNote Labs as part of their modular health data framework. The implementation enables AI assistants to discover available health metrics (weight, steps, heart rate, etc.), prepare standardized NIP-101h events for publishing, and generate instructions for fetching encrypted user health data from Nostr relays. Built with TypeScript and featuring automatic parsing of NIP-101h specifications, it supports privacy-preserving health data workflows where users maintain control over their sensitive information while enabling interoperability between health applications through standardized event formats.
